mainText: Hello, Verona! At 7 PM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 72 degrees with overcast skies at Reddan Soccer Park. The moon is in a Waning Gibbous phase, and the ISS will be visible for a 2-minute pass starting at 3:29 AM, rising in the northwest near Verona High School and moving toward the northeast near Home Depot. Tonight, the low will be 67 degrees and we should expect some rain overnight.

Mayor Luke Diaz has officially proclaimed September 2026 as Hunger Action Month. This initiative highlights that 1 in 8 residents in Southwest Wisconsin face food insecurity and encourages the community to volunteer and donate to support local efforts like the Second Harvest Foodbank.

There is a lot to do this weekend in Verona. Today, you can check out the Verona Area Kids Triathlon at the high school, live music at Bailey's Run, or live music at the Wisconsin Brewing Company. Tomorrow, check out Yoga at Insight Wellness.

In the weekly recap, on August 17 at 8:15 PM, the Verona Police Department successfully located a 21-year-old man in the 500 block of Cross Country Road and took him into custody for a probation violation.
Today's flavor of the day is the fan-favorite Crazy for Cookie Dough. Culver's is currently open and will be serving this treat until they close at 10:00 PM tonight.
